user.title: Disclaimer
user.description:
This is an unofficial integration, not affiliated with MÁV, GYSEV or holavonat.is.

- Timetable: the official MÁV GTFS timetable, downloaded with your own MÁV access.
- Delays: the unofficial holavonat.is feed (https://github.com/holavonat/holavonatis), built on an undocumented API.

**The data may be inaccurate, incomplete, delayed or unavailable at any time. The authors of this integration accept no responsibility for the data or for any consequence of its use. Always check the official operator before travelling.**

data.accept_disclaimer: I understand and accept that I use the data at my own risk
